subject: Post-demo: Stakeholder mapping & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Bryan Lee <bryan.lee@finovate.com>, Karen Wu <karen.wu@finovate.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: Stakeholder mapping & next steps

Hi Bryan / Karen —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our demo and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

What we covered
- Demo of Redwood inference runtime (latency/cost profiles) and Dedicated option.
- Example cost/latency tradeoffs for your core recommender workload.
- Security/compliance features: VPC private control plane, KMS support, audit logs.

Initial stakeholder mapping (based on our chat)
- Champion: Bryan Lee (you) — product/ML lead, will drive technical fit and pilot.
- Economic buyer: Karen Wu — CFO / finance owner for ROI approvals.
- Security/Legal: security team (we should meet to cover data flow and audit logs).
- Procurement: procurement@finovate.com — standard contract and SOW steps.

Requested assets (attached)
- Redwood ROI one-pager (redwood_roi_onepager.pdf) — short exec-friendly summary you can share with Karen.
- Mutual Action Plan (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) — draft timeline and owners that we can edit together.

Next steps (proposal)
1) Bryan to confirm economic buyer and procurement contact (or introduce) — if Karen is the right person for finance sign-off, great.
2) Karen / Finance: a 20-min exec session where I walk through the one-pager and expected unit economics.
3) Security call: 45-min with your security team to validate controls; Ethan (SE) will lead.
4) Finalize MAP and target pilot scope & dates.

Can you confirm the right procurement contact and whether Karen is the person we should present the one-pager to? If helpful, I can send a 1-slide exec summary for your CFO (I attached the one-pager already).

Thanks — talk soon,

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0128

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Stakeholder mapping & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the follow-up and the materials. Quick answers and a couple asks: 

- Confirming champion: I can drive the pilot from a product/ML side.
- Economic buyer: Karen Wu (CFO) is the right finance contact for approvals. I've CC'd her here.
- Procurement: please loop in procurement@finovate.com for contract timeline — I'll intro if needed.
- Security: I'll schedule a 45-min call with our security lead (tentatively next week).

A couple of requests to help me internally: 
1) Can you send a single-slide exec summary that I can forward directly to Karen (very short ROI bullets + high-level cost delta)?
2) Any standard procurement timeline or contract terms (SLA, data residency) you can share up front?

I'll aim to introduce you to procurement and our security lead by Friday. Appreciate the clear MAP — happy to take a first pass once procurement confirms the timeline.

Best,
Bryan
Head of Product — Recommender Systems
Finovate

Thanks Bryan — great, and thanks for CC'ing Karen. Attaching a concise exec one-pager (redwood_roi_onepager.pdf) and a draft MAP (mutual_action_plan.xlsx). Also attaching a short security/SLA summary (security_sla_summary.pdf) that covers the common questions security teams ask.

Per your asks:
- One-slide exec summary: attached (same as the one-pager) 
- Procurement timeline / contract: the MAP includes typical contract milestones and a proposed 6–8 week pilot agreement. If procurement has a standard SOW template, we can map fields directly.

Proposed next meetings (I'll send calendar invites once we confirm availability):
- Exec 15–20min with Karen to walk the ROI one-pager (Marissa + Bryan).
- Security 45min with Ethan (SE) + your security lead to go through controls + audit logs.
- Procurement sync 30min to align on contract process and timelines (procurement + legal).

Bryan — if you're comfortable, can you intro me to procurement@finovate.com and the security lead (name/email) so we can get those meetings on the calendar? I can also provide a short email template for you to forward to the CFO that summarizes key ROI bullets.

Thanks — will be ready to iterate the MAP once procurement confirms the timeline.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — internal action items

Ethan / Laura — forwarding the thread so you're up to speed. Quick internal checklist before we hop on the security and champion enablement calls: 

1) Ethan: please prepare a 30–45min security deep-dive deck that covers: network/data flow (VPC), KMS/HSM support, audit logs retention, and our SLA (refer to security_sla_summary.pdf). Bring examples of similar bank/fintech customers.
2) Laura: I need a one-page talk track for Bryan that he can forward to Karen — 3 bullets on ROI, a single pilot-cost estimate (30-day token/run example), and suggested ask (approve exec review + procurement intro). I attached the current one-pager — please tailor it to CFO language and highlight payback period.
3) Mutual Action Plan: I'll update the MAP with proposed dates; Ethan/Laura review and I'll send to Bryan for procurement/exec scheduling.

Also, below is a draft email Bryan can forward to Karen (copy and paste):

-----
Subject: Quick ROI summary — Redwood Inference
Hi Karen,
Bryan here — we had a quick demo of a model-serving platform (Redwood Inference) today. Attached is a one-page ROI summary; high level: expected 20–30% cost reduction on serving for our recommender baseline with comparable latency. Can Marissa walk you through a 15–20min exec summary this week?

Thanks,
Bryan
-----

I'll coordinate calendar invites once procurement/security confirm availability. Let me know if you want to change any bullets.

—
Marissa
